visual_action: A montage video first shows Gretchen Whitmer speaking at a podium, then at an outdoor rally, and then hugging a supporter in front of campaign signs. The video then cuts to a clip of Tudor Dixon speaking into a microphone while standing in front of an American flag.

cast.name: Gretchen Whitmer
cast.evidence: Gretchen Whitmer is shown in multiple clips and identified by both face recognition and on-screen text reading 'Governor Whitmer'.

cast.name: Tudor Dixon
cast.evidence: Tudor Dixon is shown speaking and is identified by an on-screen text overlay that reads 'Tudor Dixon'.

cast.name: Garlin Gilchrist
cast.evidence: His name appears on campaign signs in the background that read 'WHITMER GILCHRIST FOR MICHIGAN'.

on_screen_text.text: Governor Whitmer is protecting access to abortion 🥰
Tudor Dixon supports an abortion ban with no exceptions 😨✋

spoken_summary: There is no speech or dialogue in the video.
audio_music: The video starts with an upbeat, retro, 8-bit style electronic track. When the video cuts to Tudor Dixon, the music abruptly changes to a short, jarring, and ominous sound effect, similar to a 'danger' or 'enemy appears' cue in a video game.
editing_pacing: The video uses fast cuts to create a montage that contrasts two political figures.
central_claim: Governor Gretchen Whitmer protects abortion access, while her opponent Tudor Dixon supports a total ban with no exceptions.
intended_effect: To generate support for Whitmer and opposition to Dixon based on their contrasting positions on abortion.
